articles.title: Iranian attack damages Kuwait power and desalination plant, kills worker
articles.summary: Kuwaiti authorities confirm an Iranian attack on a critical power and water desalination plant in Kuwait. The assault tragically killed an Indian worker and caused significant damage to a building on site. This incident underscores the dangerously escalating regional tensions and the vulnerability of crucial civilian infrastructure amidst the volatile security environment in the Gulf.

articles.title: PLI incentives drive incremental gains in India's electronics and automotive manufacturing
articles.summary: India is demonstrating steady progress in expanding its domestic manufacturing capabilities across critical sectors such as electronics and automotive, bolstered by the "Make in India" initiative and Production-Linked Incentive (PLI) schemes. This strategic focus enhances national self-reliance, creates employment, and strengthens the industrial base, contributing significantly to economic growth and resilience.

articles.title: 10 DC Superheroes That Were Given a Lantern Ring Ranked by How Powerful It Made Them
articles.summary: This article discusses the fictional DC Universe, focusing on heroes like the Green Lanterns and various corps who have wielded Power Rings. It explores the lore surrounding these powerful artifacts, including the introduction of the Emotional Spectrum, which expanded the power ring concept beyond traditional Green Lanterns. The text details their significance in the DC mythos.

articles.title: Kerala elections: A battle to manoeuvre coalition chemistry, maths of changing milieu
articles.summary: The current Kerala assembly election is notably challenging traditional electoral math and political chemistry on the ground. Parties are actively seeking to alter established dynamics, indicating a pivotal shift in the state's political landscape. This election serves as a crucial test of evolving voter behaviour and strategic approaches, potentially reshaping Kerala's long-term political future.
